local_sequence: Freeze participant assignment and original protocol before waveform access.
Specify numerical model choices before model access to numerical human data.
Screen TRAIN clock metadata and record amendment before fitting.
Admit the seven eligible TRAIN runs and start TRAIN work.
Prepare the first public protocol edition before any DEV or FINAL access.
provenance.public_timestamp_source: Separate externally observed GitHub publication receipt for this exact edition.
provenance.commitment_scope: Digests bind the preserved records. Participant assignments and internal source records are private. The first external timestamp applies to this public edition.

cohort_and_screen.primary_task: One-hand visually paced power grip; right-hand trials only.
cohort_and_screen.coverage_scope: Source-screened scheduled issues with matching source coverage, prior to model scoring. All model scores and analysis denominators belong to a later record.

timing_and_measurement.newton_conversion_status: Usable conversion factor absent from this release.
timing_and_measurement.eeg_input_units: Released scalp amplitudes. The source unit label is milivolts. Features retain the numerical release scale.
timing_and_measurement.pairing: Match strictly increasing Go sequences across clock sources by chronological ordinal and hand. Original participant roles and clock record are retained.
timing_and_measurement.signal_processing_limit: Use no target imputation, future-sample interpolation, trial-wise normalization or additional retrospective filtering.
timing_and_measurement.native_index_arithmetic: Treat stored marker numbers as exact IEEE values. Use rational sample periods. Source boundaries are half-open with sample limits from ceil(rate * start) through ceil(rate * stop) - 1.

cue.origin: Go, the nominal first contraction instruction.
cue.measurement_scope: Scheduled task reference. Displayed waveform, feedback delivery, actual contraction transitions and display timing were unverified.

unmeasured: intra-trial physical alignment and device jitter
release-filter phase and true sensing delay
delay from acquisition to an available forecast

predictors.backward_slope: Current voltage plus 1.5 times the difference from the fourth preceding force sample.
predictors.force_history: Timing, last 20 voltages through issue and 80 ms and 200 ms slopes in volts per second.
predictors.aligned_eeg: Force history plus 24 ordered, common-average referenced EEG channel descriptor sets.
predictors.rotated_eeg: Same force features with scalp descriptors from the next trial in the same person, hand and protocol, wrapping chronologically. The donor map uses Go metadata before filtering issues.
predictors.earlier_eeg: Same force features with same-trial EEG ending 400 EEG samples earlier. The windows are disjoint.

eeg_power.preprocessing: Concurrent channel mean reference, per-channel centering before power, symmetric length-400 Hann taper; no two-sided time filter or future sample use.
eeg_power.spectrum: Unpadded real DFT. Bin mass is c[k] * abs(X[k])^2 / (400 * sum(w^2)), with c=1 at DC and Nyquist and c=2 elsewhere.

frozen_analysis.matched_row_policy: Training and evaluation each use their shared complete-case intersection across all primary branches. Report target censoring, unscorable features and phase coverage. A target at or beyond the earliest trial/session bound or nominal 21 s end is censored.

fit.training_population: Seven source-eligible TRAIN people, unless a zero-row person forces review.
fit.internal_validation: Seven leave-one-eligible-person-out folds, each fit on six people.
fit.selection: Choose the smallest participant-balanced validation RMSE per branch; exact ties take the larger penalty. Refit with all eligible training participants.
fit.objective: Weighted mean squared error plus alpha times squared standardized coefficients. Fit the intercept without penalty. Keep the target in V.
fit.preprocessing: Estimate weighted means and population scales inside each training fold; replace zero scales with one and count them.
fit.row_weight: 1 / (training participant count * trials for participant * scored issues in trial)

frozen_analysis.metric: For each participant take the square root of mean trial MSE, with equal weighting of scored issues within a trial. Average those participant RMSEs in V with equal weight.
frozen_analysis.uncertainty: Use paired participant RMSE changes, 95% descriptive Student t intervals and a two-sided exact sign test excluding ties. Report 00, 01, 10, and 11 phase strata and support.
frozen_analysis.directional_screen: Require the mean of each predeclared paired contrast to be below zero, subject to adequate integrity and coverage. A passing screen by itself cannot identify EEG source or demonstrate a transferable effect.
frozen_analysis.secondary_modalities: Optional EMG and left-hand analyses require a separate scoped protocol. They are outside this primary fit.
